dotnet.notes: Technical minimum is version-dependent: .NET 6 for Godot 4.0-4.3, .NET 8 for 4.4+ (9 for Android); .NET 8 is the current recommendation (reference 4.7), .NET 6 historical only. C# needs the .NET-enabled editor build; no C# web export. Example builds on net8.0 with Godot.NET.Sdk 4.7.2; net6.0 compatibility checked once with Godot.NET.Sdk 4.0.0.

sources.claim: A scene is a node tree with one root; a game is a tree of scenes; the main scene is set in project settings
Lifecycle callback order on entering the tree: _enter_tree parent, _enter_tree children, _ready children, _ready parent; _exit_tree is bottom-up
get_node/$/get_node_or_null; add_child/remove_child; owner needed for packing; queue_free defers to end of frame and frees children
Scene-unique names %Name are accessed from nodes in the same scene
PackedScene.instantiate() returns a node tree; pack() saves owned sub-nodes; load/preload load the resource (preload GDScript-only)
PackedScene API: instantiate, can_instantiate, pack; SceneTree.root is a Window
SceneTree.root is a Window (do not delete)
is_instance_valid checks whether an object was deleted
Godot node trees are aggregation, not composition; nodes are not components
C# has no @onready (assign in _Ready); $ is GDScript-only; GetNode<T>; GD.Load<PackedScene>; preload unavailable in C#
C# requires the .NET-enabled editor build; PascalCase API; _Process(double delta)
C# cannot export to the web platform
